title: ECB’s Vujcic warns energy shock could keep inflation hot
summary: The European Central Bank Vice President Boris Vujcic said that the ECB started a tightening cycle and sees a “risk of higher for longer energy prices” and added that diesel prices will stay for long, feeding into inflation.

title: Asian FX: Higher yields and Oil weigh – OCBC
summary: OCBC strategists Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong report that Asian FX traded broadly softer as higher Oil prices and rising US Treasury yields hurt risk sentiment, with Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) underperforming and Philippine Peso (PHP), Indian Rupee (INR) and Thai Baht (THB) also weaker.

title: Venezuela Oil Output Could Hit 1.8 Million Bpd By 2030, Rystad Says
summary: Venezuela’s upstream oil sector is attracting its broadest pool of international operators and capital in decades, with established majors expanding their footprints and new operators entering under revised contractual frameworks. If capital deployment, rig availability and oilfield services scale in line with requirements, Rystad Energy models Venezuelan crude production reaching around 1.6 million barrels per day (bpd) by 2028 and 1.8 million bpd by 2030. title: Fed’s Hammack says policy still isn’t restrictive despite high inflation
summary: Cleveland Federal Reserve (Fed) President Beth Hammack said on Friday the two sides of the Fed's dual mandate are not in conflict. She said that “high inflation complicates economic planning,” and that she doesn’t see current policy as restraining the economy.

title: Singapore Dollar: Consolidation near lows against US Dollar – UOB
summary: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note USD/SGD held steady around 1.2800 after Wednesday’s surge, with the Singapore Dollar (SGD) supported by expectations of further MAS tightening.

title: Trump and Xi meet, but hopes for AI cooperation stay slim
summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping and US President Donald Trump have been holding talks in the Oval Office at the White House. Trump gave the visiting leader of Communist China a personal tour of several of his favourite White House features. He took him aboard the Marine One helicopter, presented the new granite landing pad he had built for it, and pointed out the massive adjacent construction site where a ballroom will eventually stand.
